Nigerians Invest in Dangote Refinery Amid Wealth Surge

Many Nigerians have purchased shares in the oil refinery owned by Aliko Dangote, Africa's richest man, marking their first-ever stock investments. This surge in share-buying activity has contributed to a reshuffling of wealth rankings, with Africa's 24 billionaires now collectively $56 billion wealthier than 26 billionaires in the Middle East. Dangote's business ventures, including the refinery, are central to this shift in wealth.
